title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: the Vendor chip narrows to one vendor
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Vendors Y and W both have unpaid bills.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Unpaid Invoices" in the left list.
  3. Click the Vendor chip.
  4. Type the first letters of vendor Y.
  5. Pick vendor Y.
  6. Read the vendor groups.
  7. Reload the page.
  8. Read the vendor groups.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 6:

  • only vendor Y.

Step 8:

  • still only vendor Y.

Why this matters: Payables staff work one vendor statement at a time.
